;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2018 Strasbourg attack]]
**A [[Polish people|Polish]] national who was wounded during a terrorist attack in [[Strasbourg]], [[France]], dies of his injuries, raising the death toll to five. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-46586969 (BBC)]
*[[Tulare County shootings]]
**A gunman kills two people and wounds seven others in a shooting spree across [[Tulare County, California]]. The gunman is identified as an undocumented immigrant. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/nation/2018/12/20/after-shooting-suspects-reign-terror-california-sheriff-blames-states-sanctuary-law/ (''The Washington Post'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*A gas blast in a restaurant in [[Sapporo]], [[Japan]], injures 42 people. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-46585564 (BBC)]
*A bus crash in [[Zurich]], [[Switzerland]], kills one person and injures 44 others. [https://www.tgcom24.mediaset.it/mondo/svizzera-pullman-da-genova-si-schianta-vicino-a-zurigo-morta-un-italiana-44-i-feriti_3180763-201802a.shtml (Tgcom24)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2018 Sri Lankan constitutional crisis]]
**[[Ranil Wickremesinghe]] is sworn in as [[Prime Minister of Sri Lanka]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-sri-lanka-politics/wickremesinghe-returns-as-sri-lanka-pm-as-crisis-nears-end-idUSKBN1OF02N (Reuters)]
*[[Georgian presidential election, 2018]]
**[[Salome Zurabishvili]] takes office as [[President of Georgia]]. Zurabishvili is the first woman in office and the last president to be elected by popular vote. [https://www.dw.com/en/georgia-swears-in-salome-zurabishvili-as-first-female-president/a-46763518 (Deutsche Welle)]

;Sports
*[[2018 Men's Hockey World Cup]]
** In [[field hockey]], [[Belgium men's national field hockey team|Belgium]] wins the title, defeating the [[Netherlands men's national field hockey team|Netherlands]] 3–2 in a [[Sudden death (sport)|sudden death]] [[Penalty shootout|shootout]]. After regular playing time, the score was 0–0.
